guestWindowOcclusion.source: Guest operator observation supplied with the capture
guestWindowOcclusion.report: Neutral host was largely behind Explorer after launch; Explorer remained foreground in subsequent views. Focus and occlusion were not adjusted during the run.
guestWindowOcclusion.staticScreenshotInspection: Both retained images show Explorer foreground. They do not prove continuous per-arm visibility or presented frame timing.

analyzer.scope: Fatal page JSON and duplicate-key checks, exact transport/artifact protocol, natural process closure flags, source/manifest/kernel/ISO identity, fixed observed geometry and page arithmetic

observation.rafCallbacks: Candidate observed more JavaScript rAF callbacks and lower gap median/p95/max in both architectures in this single run.
observation.messageCompletion: Candidate 256-message completion span was longer in both architectures; this tradeoff remains in the recorded comparison.
observation.interpretation: The short run establishes task completion and natural closure, and records contrasting callback/message timing observations. It does not establish a general throughput or perceptual performance conclusion.
